```{r setup}
# ============================================================
# Libraries
# ============================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(ggh4x)
  library(cowplot)
  library(Biostrings)
  library(qs2)
})

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================
PROJECT_DIR    <- "/path/to/project"
NANORANGER_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "nanoranger")   # panels + mutation files (preprocessing/nanoranger)
OUT_DIR        <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010_1026")  # benchmark tables + VEP files
FIG_DIR        <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "figure1")
dir.create(FIG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# Inputs
#   - Seurat objects: AML1010/AML1026_scrna_preprocessing.R
#   - benchmark mutation lists: extract_mutations_AML1010/AML1026.R
# ============================================================
obj_1010 <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/obj_1010_with_BoneMarrowMap_Broad_final.qs2"))
obj_1026 <- qs2::qs_read(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1026/objects/obj_1026_with_BoneMarrowMap_Broad_final.qs2"))

AML1010_benchmark <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1010/objects/AML1010_benchmark_mutation_data_list_inSeurat.rds"))
AML1026_benchmark <- readRDS(file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "AML1026/objects/AML1026_benchmark_mutation_data_list_inSeurat.rds"))

# ============================================================
# Shared settings
# ============================================================
COVERAGE_MIN <- 1   # a cell counts as genotyped for a target with >= 1 read (alt + ref)

# Okabe-Ito (colorblind-safe)
PROTOCOL_COLORS <- c(
  rhPCR         = "#0072B2",
  taqman        = "#E69F00",
  taqman_biotin = "#009E73"
)
```

```{r VEP input}
# ============================================================
# Write Ensembl VEP input files from the nanoranger mutation lists.
# VEP is then run externally (with MANE annotation); its tab-separated
# output (<patient>_VEP.txt in OUT_DIR) is read in the next chunk.
# ============================================================
write_vep_input <- function(mut_path, out_path) {
  readr::read_csv(mut_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      chromosome = sub("^chr", "", chr),
      start      = as.integer(pos),
      end        = as.integer(pos),
      allele     = paste0(ref, "/", alt),
      strand     = "+",
      identifier = paste(sample, gene, chr, pos, ref, alt, sep = "_")
    ) %>%
    readr::write_tsv(out_path, col_names = FALSE)
}

write_vep_input(file.path(NANORANGER_DIR, "mutations/mutations.1010.csv"), file.path(OUT_DIR, "AML1010_VEP_input.txt"))
write_vep_input(file.path(NANORANGER_DIR, "mutations/mutations.1026.csv"), file.path(OUT_DIR, "AML1026_VEP_input.txt"))
```

```{r benchmark info tables}
# ============================================================
# Per-target benchmark table (one row per targeted variant):
#   VEP MANE_Select annotation, distance to 5' end, transcript length,
#   genotyped cells + genotyping efficiency per protocol, expression metrics.
#   Denominator = all cells of the benchmark sample.
# ============================================================
build_benchmark_info <- function(obj, benchmark_list, bench_sample, vep_path, mut_path, fasta_path) {

  # ---- benchmark cells (denominator) ----
  bench_cells <- colnames(obj)[startsWith(colnames(obj), paste0(bench_sample, "_"))]
  n_bench_cells <- length(bench_cells)
  stopifnot(n_bench_cells > 0)

  # ---- VEP (MANE_Select) restricted to mutation genes + distance to 5' ----
  mutations <- readr::read_csv(mut_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  vep_mane <- readr::read_tsv(vep_path, comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(MANE == "MANE_Select") %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(mutations, by = c("SYMBOL" = "gene")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cdna_pos = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(cDNA_position, "^[0-9]+")),
      distance_to_5p = cdna_pos - 1
    )

  # ---- transcript length from the panel FASTA ----
  fasta <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fasta_path)

  fasta_df <- tibble::tibble(
    fasta_header = stringr::str_trim(names(fasta)),
    gene = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_extract(names(fasta), "^[^\\-|]+")),
    transcript = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_extract(names(fasta), "ENST[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")),
    transcript_length = Biostrings::width(fasta)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, transcript, .keep_all = TRUE)

  vep_mane <- vep_mane %>%
    dplyr::left_join(fasta_df %>% dplyr::select(transcript, transcript_length),
                     by = c("Feature" = "transcript"))
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(vep_mane$transcript_length)))

  # ---- genotyping efficiency (wide; NA -> 0) ----
  geno_eff_wide <- purrr::imap_dfr(
    benchmark_list,
    function(df, gene_name) {
      df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(gene = gene_name) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          bc = as.character(bc),
          protocol = as.character(protocol),
          gene = as.character(gene),
          coverage = as.integer(alt) + as.integer(ref),
          sample_name = as.character(sample_name)
        )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample_name == bench_sample, bc %in% bench_cells, gene %in% vep_mane$SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, protocol, bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(coverage = max(coverage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotyped = coverage >= COVERAGE_MIN) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, protocol) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_genotyped_cells = sum(genotyped),
      n_total_cells = n_bench_cells,
      genotyping_efficiency = n_genotyped_cells / n_total_cells,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(protocol = make.names(protocol)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(gene, n_total_cells),
      names_from = protocol,
      values_from = c(n_genotyped_cells, genotyping_efficiency),
      names_sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        tidyselect::matches("^n_genotyped_cells_|^genotyping_efficiency_"),
        ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)
      )
    )

  # ---- expression metrics (mean counts + fraction expressing) ----
  counts <- Seurat::GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  expr_df <- tibble::tibble(SYMBOL = unique(vep_mane$SYMBOL)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      expr_mean_counts = vapply(SYMBOL, function(g) {
        if (!g %in% rownames(counts)) return(NA_real_)
        mean(as.numeric(counts[g, bench_cells, drop = TRUE]))
      }, numeric(1)),
      expr_frac_expressing = vapply(SYMBOL, function(g) {
        if (!g %in% rownames(counts)) return(NA_real_)
        mean(as.numeric(counts[g, bench_cells, drop = TRUE]) >= 1)
      }, numeric(1))
    )

  # ---- final table ----
  vep_mane %>%
    dplyr::left_join(geno_eff_wide, by = c("SYMBOL" = "gene")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(expr_df, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
    dplyr::select(
      `#Uploaded_variation`, Location, Allele, Consequence,
      SYMBOL, Gene, Feature_type, Feature, BIOTYPE, EXON,
      cDNA_position, CDS_position, Protein_position, Amino_acids, Codons,
      Existing_variation, REF_ALLELE, UPLOADED_ALLELE, STRAND,
      MANE, MANE_SELECT,
      cdna_pos, distance_to_5p, transcript_length, n_total_cells,
      n_genotyped_cells_rhPCR, n_genotyped_cells_taqman, n_genotyped_cells_taqman_biotin,
      genotyping_efficiency_rhPCR, genotyping_efficiency_taqman, genotyping_efficiency_taqman_biotin,
      expr_mean_counts, expr_frac_expressing
    )
}

AML1010_benchmark_info <- build_benchmark_info(
  obj            = obj_1010,
  benchmark_list = AML1010_benchmark,
  bench_sample   = "AML1010.1",
  vep_path       = file.path(OUT_DIR, "AML1010_VEP.txt"),
  mut_path       = file.path(NANORANGER_DIR, "mutations/mutations.1010.csv"),
  fasta_path     = file.path(NANORANGER_DIR, "panel/panel_MT_trns_extended_1010.fa")
)

AML1026_benchmark_info <- build_benchmark_info(
  obj            = obj_1026,
  benchmark_list = AML1026_benchmark,
  bench_sample   = "AML1026.1",
  vep_path       = file.path(OUT_DIR, "AML1026_VEP.txt"),
```

```{r boxplots genotyped cells and efficiency}
# ============================================================
# Two side-by-side boxplots per protocol (8 x 8 cm)
#   (1) Y = genotyped cells per target
#   (2) Y = genotyping efficiency per target
# One point = one (sample, target, protocol)
# ============================================================
BOX_PROTOCOL_ORDER <- c("rhPCR", "taqman_biotin", "taqman")
DOT_SPREAD <- 0.30
BASE_SIZE  <- 6

# benchmark_info -> long tidy table
tidy_benchmark_info <- function(info_tbl, sample_label) {

  info_tbl2 <- info_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample = sample_label,
      gene_symbol = as.character(.data[["SYMBOL"]]),
      target_id = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(.data[["#Uploaded_variation"]]),
        as.character(.data[["#Uploaded_variation"]]),
        as.character(dplyr::row_number())
      )
    )

  counts_long <- info_tbl2 %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::starts_with("n_genotyped_cells_"),
      names_to = "protocol",
      values_to = "n_genotyped",
      names_prefix = "n_genotyped_cells_"
    )

  eff_long <- info_tbl2 %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::starts_with("genotyping_efficiency_"),
      names_to = "protocol",
      values_to = "genotyping_efficiency",
      names_prefix = "genotyping_efficiency_"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(sample, target_id, protocol, genotyping_efficiency)

  counts_long %>%
    dplyr::left_join(eff_long, by = c("sample", "target_id", "protocol")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      protocol = factor(protocol, levels = BOX_PROTOCOL_ORDER),
      gene = gene_symbol
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(protocol)) %>%
    dplyr::select(sample, target_id, gene, protocol, n_genotyped, genotyping_efficiency)
}

box_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tidy_benchmark_info(AML1010_benchmark_info, "AML1010"),
  tidy_benchmark_info(AML1026_benchmark_info, "AML1026")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x_center = as.numeric(protocol)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(x_center)) %>%
  # deterministic no-overlap x positions
  dplyr::group_by(protocol) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(protocol, sample, gene, target_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_in_protocol = dplyr::n(),
    idx = dplyr::row_number(),
    offset = dplyr::if_else(
      n_in_protocol == 1L,
      0,
      -DOT_SPREAD + (idx - 1) * (2 * DOT_SPREAD) / (n_in_protocol - 1)
    ),
    x = x_center + offset
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

pub_theme_nogrid <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = BASE_SIZE) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(1, "pt"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "pt")
  )

# one boxplot panel; y_col = column to plot
box_panel <- function(data, y_col, y_name, y_labels = ggplot2::waiver()) {
  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[y_col]]))
  ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(y = .data[[y_col]])) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      ggplot2::aes(x = x_center, group = protocol, fill = protocol),
      outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, linewidth = 0.25, color = "black", alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, fill = protocol),
      shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.12, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = PROTOCOL_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(BOX_PROTOCOL_ORDER),
      labels = BOX_PROTOCOL_ORDER,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      name = y_name,
      labels = y_labels,
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL) +
    pub_theme_nogrid
}

p_cells <- box_panel(box_df, "n_genotyped", "Genotyped cells per target")
p_eff   <- box_panel(box_df, "genotyping_efficiency", "Genotyping efficiency %",
                     y_labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1))

p_combined <- p_cells + p_eff + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 2)
print(p_combined)

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "benchmark_boxplots_cells_and_efficiency.pdf"),
                plot = p_combined, width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm", useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "benchmark_boxplots_cells_and_efficiency.png"),
                plot = p_combined, width = 8, height = 8, units = "cm", dpi = 320)
```

```{r per-target barplots}
# ============================================================
# AML1010.1 + AML1026.1: fraction of cells genotyped per target and protocol
# Two facet_wrap blocks side-by-side with equal panel size
# ============================================================
BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER <- c("rhPCR", "taqman", "taqman_biotin")
PROT_X <- c(rhPCR = 1.00, taqman = 1.28, taqman_biotin = 1.56)

BAR_WIDTH <- 0.14
X_LIM_PAD <- 0.12
Y_MAX <- 0.60

BASE_FONT <- 9
LABEL_SIZE <- 2.7
PANEL_SPACING_LINES <- 0.30

# facet layout (panel size stays constant)
NCOL_1010 <- 4
NCOL_1026 <- 3

# fixed facet panel physical size (inches)
PANEL_W <- 1.25
PANEL_H <- 1.15
OUTER_W <- 1.8
OUTER_H <- 1.6

GENES_1010 <- c("RALY","MCM7","SPNS1","ACIN1","TCF12","TCF12_2","THAP7","C4orf33","CYFIP2","ZNF407","NRAS","RNPEPL1","E2F3")
GENES_1026 <- c("CSNK1D","MARS1","PNKP","GNB1","LPGAT1","CCDC88B","SRSF2","SF3B1","NRAS")

prot_x <- PROT_X[names(PROT_X) %in% BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER]
x_breaks <- unname(prot_x)
x_min <- min(x_breaks) - X_LIM_PAD
x_max <- max(x_breaks) + X_LIM_PAD
prot_cols <- PROTOCOL_COLORS[names(PROTOCOL_COLORS) %in% BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER]

bar_theme <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = BASE_FONT) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(PANEL_SPACING_LINES, "lines"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = grid::unit(0.7, "cm")
    )
}

# per-sample table: fraction of benchmark cells genotyped per (gene, protocol)
build_sample_df <- function(bench_sample, obj, benchmark_list, gene_order) {

  all_cells <- colnames(obj)
  bench_cells <- all_cells[startsWith(all_cells, paste0(bench_sample, "_"))]
  if (length(bench_cells) == 0) stop("No benchmark cells for ", bench_sample)
  n_bench_cells <- length(bench_cells)

  targeted_genes <- sort(unique(names(benchmark_list)))
  genes_use <- gene_order[gene_order %in% targeted_genes]
  if (length(genes_use) == 0) stop("No requested targets found for ", bench_sample)

  geno_obs <- purrr::imap_dfr(benchmark_list, ~ dplyr::mutate(.x, gene = .y)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      bc = as.character(bc),
      protocol = as.character(protocol),
      gene = as.character(gene),
      coverage = as.integer(alt) + as.integer(ref),
      sample_name = as.character(sample_name)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample_name == bench_sample) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, protocol, bc) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(coverage = max(coverage, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotyped = coverage >= COVERAGE_MIN) %>%
    dplyr::filter(bc %in% bench_cells, gene %in% genes_use, protocol %in% BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER)

  if (nrow(geno_obs) == 0) stop("geno_obs empty for ", bench_sample)

  tidyr::expand_grid(bc = bench_cells, gene = genes_use, protocol = BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(geno_obs, bc, gene, protocol, genotyped),
                     by = c("bc", "gene", "protocol")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(genotyped = tidyr::replace_na(genotyped, FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, protocol) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = dplyr::n(),
      n_genotyped = sum(genotyped),
      frac_genotyped = n_genotyped / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample = bench_sample,
      n_bench_cells = n_bench_cells,
      gene = factor(gene, levels = genes_use),
      protocol = factor(protocol, levels = BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER),
      x = unname(prot_x[as.character(protocol)]),
      label = ifelse(n_genotyped == 0, "", as.character(n_genotyped))
    )
}

bar_1010 <- build_sample_df("AML1010.1", obj_1010, AML1010_benchmark, GENES_1010)
bar_1026 <- build_sample_df("AML1026.1", obj_1026, AML1026_benchmark, GENES_1026)

# pad the smaller block (AML1026) with empty facets so both blocks have the same number of rows
nrow_1010 <- ceiling(length(levels(bar_1010$gene)) / NCOL_1010)
nrow_1026 <- ceiling(length(levels(bar_1026$gene)) / NCOL_1026)
target_rows <- max(nrow_1010, nrow_1026)
need_dummy <- target_rows * NCOL_1026 - length(levels(bar_1026$gene))

if (need_dummy > 0) {
  dummy_genes <- paste0("ZZ_dummy_", seq_len(need_dummy))
  dummy_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(gene = dummy_genes, protocol = BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_total = NA_integer_,
      n_genotyped = 0L,
      frac_genotyped = 0,
      sample = "AML1026.1",
      n_bench_cells = unique(bar_1026$n_bench_cells),
      protocol = factor(protocol, levels = BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER),
      x = unname(prot_x[as.character(protocol)]),
      label = ""
    )
  bar_1026 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bar_1026, dummy_df) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = factor(as.character(gene), levels = c(levels(bar_1026$gene), dummy_genes)))
}

# one facetted bar block per sample
bar_block <- function(data, ncol, title, y_lab, labeller = "label_value") {
  ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = frac_genotyped, fill = protocol)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = label), vjust = -0.35, size = LABEL_SIZE) +
    ggh4x::facet_wrap2(~ gene, ncol = ncol, scales = "fixed", axes = "all", labeller = labeller) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks, limits = c(x_min, x_max)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                                expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, Y_MAX)) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = prot_cols, breaks = BAR_PROTOCOL_ORDER) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, y = y_lab) +
    bar_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
}

p1010 <- bar_block(bar_1010, NCOL_1010,
                   paste0("AML1010.1 (n=", unique(bar_1010$n_bench_cells), ")"),
                   "Fraction of cells genotyped")
p1026 <- bar_block(bar_1026, NCOL_1026,
                   paste0("AML1026.1 (n=", unique(bar_1026$n_bench_cells), ")"),
                   NULL,
                   labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(function(g) ifelse(grepl("^ZZ_dummy_", g), "", g))) +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank())

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ggplot2::ggplot(bar_1010, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = frac_genotyped, fill = protocol)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +

    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = BASE_FONT) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank())
)

combined <- (p1010 | p1026) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(NCOL_1010, NCOL_1026)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Genotyping yield per target (background = all cells)")

final_plot <- combined / patchwork::wrap_elements(legend)

W <- OUTER_W + PANEL_W * (NCOL_1010 + NCOL_1026)
H <- OUTER_H + PANEL_H * target_rows + 0.9

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "benchmark_barplots_per_target.png"), final_plot, width = W, height = H, dpi = 300)
```

```{r efficiency vs target features}
# ============================================================
# Genotyping efficiency vs target features (AML1010 + AML1026 pooled)
#   - one point per (mutation, protocol); top 3 per protocol labelled
#   - linear fit per protocol with R^2 and slope p-value per facet
# ============================================================
FEAT_PROTOCOL_ORDER <- c("rhPCR", "taqman", "taqman_biotin")

feat_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  AML1010_benchmark_info %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1010"),
  AML1026_benchmark_info %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1026")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mutation_id = paste0(sample, ":", `#Uploaded_variation`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    mutation_id, SYMBOL,
    transcript_length, distance_to_5p, expr_mean_counts, expr_frac_expressing,
    dplyr::starts_with("genotyping_efficiency_"),
    dplyr::starts_with("n_genotyped_cells_"),
    n_total_cells
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::matches("^(genotyping_efficiency|n_genotyped_cells)_(.+)$"),
    names_to = c(".value", "protocol"),
    names_pattern = "^(genotyping_efficiency|n_genotyped_cells)_(.+)$"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    protocol = stringr::str_replace_all(protocol, "\\.", "_"),
    protocol = factor(protocol, levels = FEAT_PROTOCOL_ORDER),
    genotyping_efficiency = dplyr::coalesce(genotyping_efficiency, 0),
    n_genotyped_cells = dplyr::coalesce(n_genotyped_cells, 0L),
    eff_pct = 100 * genotyping_efficiency
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(protocol) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rank_eff = dplyr::min_rank(dplyr::desc(eff_pct)),
    label_me = rank_eff <= 3
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# per-protocol linear model stats: R^2 + p-value of the slope
lm_stats_by_protocol <- function(data, x_col) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(protocol) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(.data[[x_col]]) & !is.na(eff_pct)),
      fit = list(stats::lm(eff_pct ~ .data[[x_col]], data = dplyr::pick(dplyr::everything()))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      r_squared = purrr::map_dbl(fit, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
      p_value   = purrr::map_dbl(fit, ~ {
        co <- summary(.x)$coefficients
        if (nrow(co) >= 2) co[2, "Pr(>|t|)"] else NA_real_
      }),
      label = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(p_value),
        sprintf("R² = %.2f\np = NA", r_squared),
        sprintf("R² = %.2f\np = %s", r_squared, scales::pvalue(p_value, accuracy = 0.001))
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(protocol, n, r_squared, p_value, label)
}

feat_theme <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}

scatter_eff <- function(data, x, xlab, xscale = c("identity", "log10")) {
  xscale <- match.arg(xscale)
  stats_df <- lm_stats_by_protocol(data, x)

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x]], y = eff_pct)) +
    # regression line with confidence band, black outline, colored line on top
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(ggplot2::aes(color = protocol), method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.15) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(ggplot2::aes(group = protocol), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(ggplot2::aes(color = protocol), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.7) +
    # points: black outline + protocol-colored fill
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = protocol), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, size = 2.8, alpha = 0.95) +
    # labels (top 3 per protocol)
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = data %>% dplyr::filter(label_me),
      ggplot2::aes(label = SYMBOL, color = protocol),
      size = 2.6, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.25, min.segment.length = 0, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # R^2 + p-value per facet
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = stats_df, ggplot2::aes(label = label),
      x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.05,
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.0, color = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ protocol, nrow = 1) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = PROTOCOL_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = PROTOCOL_COLORS, drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 51), clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = xlab, y = "Genotyping efficiency (%)", color = NULL) +
    feat_theme() +
    ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(5.5, 12, 5.5, 5.5))

  if (xscale == "log10") {
    p <- p + ggplot2::scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number())
  }
  p
}

p_len       <- scatter_eff(feat_df, "transcript_length",    "Transcript length (nt)",                  "log10")
p_5p        <- scatter_eff(feat_df, "distance_to_5p",       "Distance from 5′ end (nt)",               "log10")
p_expr_mean <- scatter_eff(feat_df, "expr_mean_counts",     "Mean expression (counts per cell)",       "log10")
p_expr_frac <- scatter_eff(feat_df, "expr_frac_expressing", "Fraction of cells expressing (counts ≥ 1)", "identity") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25))

fig <- (p_len | p_5p) / (p_expr_mean | p_expr_frac) +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "efficiency_vs_features.pdf"), fig, width = 14, height = 10, units = "in", useDingbats = FALSE)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "efficiency_vs_features.png"), fig, width = 14, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 350)

# stats table for all feature x protocol combinations
FEATURES <- c(
  transcript_length    = "Transcript length (nt)",
  distance_to_5p       = "Distance from 5′ end (nt)",
  expr_mean_counts     = "Mean expression (counts per cell)",
  expr_frac_expressing = "Fraction of cells expressing"
)
feature_stats <- purrr::imap_dfr(FEATURES, function(feature_label, feature_col) {
  lm_stats_by_protocol(feat_df, feature_col) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(feature = feature_col, feature_label = feature_label, .before = 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(-label)
})
feature_stats
readr::write_tsv(feature_stats, file.path(FIG_DIR, "efficiency_vs_features_stats.tsv"))
```

```{r benchmark metrics}
# ============================================================
# Numbers reported in the text
# ============================================================

# ---- 1) rhPCR vs taqman: per-variant concordance + pooled efficiency ----
all_info <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  AML1010_benchmark_info %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1010"),
  AML1026_benchmark_info %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1026")
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample, SYMBOL, n_total_cells,
    n_rhPCR    = n_genotyped_cells_rhPCR,
    n_taqman   = n_genotyped_cells_taqman,
    eff_rhPCR  = genotyping_efficiency_rhPCR,
    eff_taqman = genotyping_efficiency_taqman
  )

# global weighted efficiency (pooled across both samples/variants)
global_eff <- all_info %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    rhPCR  = sum(n_rhPCR,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_total_cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    taqman = sum(n_taqman, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n_total_cells, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# variant-level concordance + median per-variant difference
pairwise_rt <- all_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(eff_rhPCR), !is.na(eff_taqman)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(delta = eff_rhPCR - eff_taqman)

cor_test <- stats::cor.test(pairwise_rt$eff_rhPCR, pairwise_rt$eff_taqman, method = "spearman")
median_delta <- stats::median(pairwise_rt$delta, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf(
  "Spearman r = %.2f, p = %.3g\nMedian per-variant Δ (rhPCR - direct) = %.4f (%.2f%% points)\nGlobal efficiency: rhPCR = %.1f%%, direct = %.1f%%\n",
  unname(cor_test$estimate), cor_test$p.value,
  median_delta, 100 * median_delta,
  100 * global_eff$rhPCR, 100 * global_eff$taqman
))

# ---- 2) cell-level efficiency: cells with >= 1 genotyped target / all cells of the sample ----
# mode = "present": a cell counts if it appears at least once for that protocol
# mode = "covered": a cell counts only if alt + ref > 0 at least once for that protocol
cell_level_efficiency <- function(benchmark_list, total_cells, mode = c("present", "covered")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  df <- dplyr::bind_rows(benchmark_list, .id = "target_id") %>%
    dplyr::select(bc, protocol, alt, ref)
  if (mode == "covered") {
    df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(alt), !is.na(ref), (alt + ref) > 0)
  }
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(protocol) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_cells_with_ge1_target = dplyr::n_distinct(bc), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(total_cells = total_cells,
                  cell_level_eff = n_cells_with_ge1_target / total_cells)
}

total_1010 <- max(AML1010_benchmark_info$n_total_cells, na.rm = TRUE)
total_1026 <- max(AML1026_benchmark_info$n_total_cells, na.rm = TRUE)

cell_efficiency <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cell_level_efficiency(AML1010_benchmark, total_1010, mode = "present") %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1010"),
  cell_level_efficiency(AML1026_benchmark, total_1026, mode = "present") %>% dplyr::mutate(sample = "AML1026")
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(sample, protocol)
print(cell_efficiency)

# pooled across both samples (weighted by total cells)
pooled_present <- cell_efficiency %>%
  dplyr::group_by(protocol) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells_with_ge1_target = sum(n_cells_with_ge1_target),
    total_cells = sum(total_cells),
    pooled_cell_level_eff = n_cells_with_ge1_target / total_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(pooled_present)
```
